name: Aonyobo
depicted_variant: Blue court-woman spirit with white makeup and black teeth, turning during grooming.

visual_requirements.description: Blue-skinned court woman; layered tattered kimono, white makeup, high painted brows and black teeth
Ruined noble house within abandoned bamboo grove, fixes her hair

aura: Blue skin c02, white makeup/high brows/black teeth c03 and sudden grooming interruption c04 create uncanny confrontation.
artistic_choices: No documented power: uncanny blue skin, black teeth and abruptly confronting viewer supply menace.
Oil lamp, plain comb, exact close framing and abrupt head turn are editorial action from grooming account c04.
Opaque many-layered kimono; no giant body, horns, claws or demonic additions.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Aonyobo, the uncanny blue-skinned court-woman yokai in a ruined noble residence.
ANATOMY: ONE adult female humanoid yokai, one head and two eyes, TWO arms and two legs under many fully opaque layered ancient Japanese court kimono, tattered and moth-eaten but body always covered; visibly deep BLUE skin at neck, hands and ears; thick chalk WHITE face makeup with VERY HIGH painted eyebrows and visibly BLACKENED normal human teeth; elaborate old court hair, no horns, fangs or claws [c02,c03]
MOMENT: Whip her head around from fixing her hair toward the intruding viewer, lean abruptly close, mouth partly open displaying blackened teeth, one blue hand still lifting a plain unlettered comb beside hair, other blue hand grips frayed robe; fixed accusing stare, no smile [c04]
POWER: no documented visible magic; uncanny appearance, abrupt motion and abandoned dwelling alone create menace. No glowing eyes, spectral mist, levitation, poverty rays or invented curse effects
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; tight very low three-quarter face close-up, white face and black teeth dominate upper square, blue hands and neck plainly visible even at thumbnail; normal human height, no giant scale
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant old oil lamp low to one side offscreen, warm amber rim light, deepest walnut shadows, thin ordinary dust in room
SURFACE: cracked chalk cosmetic over blue skin, ink-black teeth, dry coarse ancient brocade and moth holes, fraying kimono layers, dusty hair
SETTING: abandoned former noble house inside a ruined bamboo grove, broken wooden wall reveals dark bamboo at edge [c04,c05]
MOOD: dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoinscriptions, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film, game, anime or comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes. Strong painterly brushwork, not plastic 3D.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one head/two eyes, two arms, blue hands/neck/ear plainly visible, white painted face, high painted brows and blackened teeth, many tattered opaque kimono layers. Abrupt hostile turn interrupts grooming c04; no horns/fangs/claws or invented magic. Ruined house/bamboo c04/c05 visible. Uncanny close confrontation reads at 200px. All seven Sangar checks pass.
